goal:
PoE1 3.30 Covens of Umbra, softcore trade. Make multiple mirrors through farming, crafting and investing.
Wanted: 5 for mapping AND 5 for bossing.
What the 3.30 patch changed for build choice: item rarity now decides drop pools, so killing rares, uniques and Fate-empowered bosses pays more than raw pack clear. Winter Orb was nerfed hard (2 projectiles, 70% effectiveness, about 15% less base damage). Golems and mercenaries were nerfed. Pathfinder, Trickster and Warden were buffed. Energy Shield uniques got buffs.

builds.name: Winter Orb Occultist
builds.notes: Most played Winter Orb version in Allflame (4.5%, #2 overall). Starts cheap (Tuadh's Exarch & Eater league start run was ~3 div) and scales very high: a 3.30 PoB shows ~117M DPS with 162k EHP on ~120 div. The 5/5 scores are for the invested version (roughly 50-120 div); expect about 4/4 in the first days.
builds.patch: NERFED in 3.30: Winter Orb now fires 2 projectiles at every level (was 2-3), 70% added damage effectiveness (was 80%), 307-460 base cold at level 20 (was 360-539). Still a cheap starter, but no longer 5/5.

builds.name: Toxic Rain Pathfinder
builds.notes: Called 'The Fastest League Start Build in Allflame League'. Very forgiving on day 1, flasks keep it safe.
builds.patch: Pathfinder was buffed in 3.30 (Master Alchemist removes all ailments on flask use; Master Distiller gives 30% penetration and +100% crit multi). Safe starter, but bossing still trails the DoT and brand picks.

builds.name: Lightning Arrow Deadeye
builds.notes: Fubgun's go-to league starter. Fastest clear for farming strategies; weak bosser until geared. Mirror-tier gear makes it absurd.
builds.patch: Pathfinder/Deadeye bows unchanged. Best pure clear, but the new rarity rules reward killing strong monsters more than fast clear. Bossing is its weak point.

builds.name: Winter Orb Elementalist
builds.notes: Fubgun's Allflame starter (most viewed guide). Winter Orb Occultist and Elementalist were the #2 and #3 builds on poe.ninja at league end.
builds.patch: NERFED in 3.30 (same Winter Orb nerf). Elementalist golem nodes were also weakened by the golem nerf.

builds.name: Kinetic Blast of Clustering Necromancer
builds.notes: Fast wand clear. Its 21/20 gem sold for 387c on day 3 last league, so its gems are worth levelling if it is popular again.
builds.patch: Unchanged, but weak bossing matters more now that strong monsters drop the valuable currency.

builds.name: Cold DoT Occultist
builds.tags: 5/5 mapping + bossing, DoT, energy shield, untouched by 3.30 nerfs
builds.notes: bLut posted a 3.30 '100 Div Endgame' version (Creeping Frost + Vortex) two days ago. One-button mapper that scales into strong bossing, fast campaign. Post-patch tier lists rate it 5 league start, 5 endgame, 5 mapping.
builds.patch: PICK for 3.30. Not touched by any nerf (only Winter Orb and golems were hit in the Witch tree). DoT ticks while you dodge Fate mechanics, and bossing reaches 5 with investment (tier lists give 4 on a budget).

builds.name: Righteous Fire Chieftain
builds.notes: Most played build in Allflame at league end (4.6%). Very tanky for heavily juiced maps; needs life and regen gear first.
builds.patch: Unchanged. Survives anything but kills Fate bosses slowly; tier lists give it 2/5 for Fate bossing.

builds.name: Shockwave Cyclone Slayer
builds.notes: Melee map blaster. Cyclone of Tumult and Void Shockwave Slayers were both top 10 at league end.
builds.patch: Unchanged. Cyclone of Tumult Slayer rated 4 for bossing and 5 for mapping on post-patch lists.

builds.name: Animate Guardian Luminary
builds.notes: Top 4 in Allflame. Luminary was introduced with Allflame; check if it stays in 3.30.
builds.patch: Luminary still exists in 3.30, but mercenaries were nerfed hard (-60% resistances in maps, less damage). Avoid.

builds.name: Penance Brand Elementalist
builds.notes: Rated 5 for Fate bossing and 5 for mapping on post-patch tier lists, with top boss damage and defences; brands keep hitting while you move. Was #6 most played in Allflame (2.3%).
builds.patch: Mostly unchanged, but check whether the guide relies on golems with Liege of the Primordial: golem buffs were cut about 20-25% in 3.30.

builds.name: Bifurcating Crit Blade Vortex Assassin
builds.notes: Rated 5 endgame, 5 Fate bossing, 5 mapping, but only 3 for league start: needs gear before it shines.
builds.patch: Unchanged in 3.30. Best as a second character once the Cold DoT Occultist is farming.

builds.name: Earthshatter Berserker
builds.notes: Tier lists call it the safest 3.30 starter; racers took it to level 99 in SSF by day three last league.
builds.patch: Unchanged. Great all-rounder, but 4/4 rather than 5/5.

builds.name: Explosive Arrow Ballista Hierophant
builds.notes: The most watched 3.30 league start plan so far (POEGuy, about 60k views).
builds.patch: New Artillery Quiver implicit (+1 maximum totems for attack skills) helps ballista builds.
